# Startup program

## Attio for startups.

Build on the CRM for the next generation. Get 80% off Attio and benefits to help your startup grow.

# 80% off Attio. Benefits built for startups.

Startups must be venture-backed or affiliated with one of our Startup Partners to qualify.

## The CRM that grows as fast as you do.

Attio is the agentic CRM built for how startups actually work — flexible enough to fit your motion today, powerful enough to scale with you tomorrow.

## Frequently asked questions

###

A lot of early-stage founders are using CRM as a founder-led sales tool. Attio works just as well for a founder managing relationships solo as it does for a full GTM team. Many of our startup customers start with one or two users and scale up as they grow.

###

Yes. Attio makes it straightforward to migrate your data from HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, [and more](https://attio.com/help/reference/imports-exports/migrate-data-from-another-crm). Most teams are up and running in a matter of hours, not weeks.

###

Members get exclusive deals on tools built for high-growth startups. That includes discounts on products like Mercury, Linear, Notion, Intercom, Sentry, Apollo, Miro, and more. You can browse the full catalogue once you're in the program.

###

Startups that meet all the following criteria: VC-backed or affiliated with one of our Startup Partners, signed up within the last 90 days, and incorporated less than 5 years ago.

This discount is valid for workspaces of up to 10 seats.

###

A member of our team will be in touch to confirm your eligibility and get you started.

###

Yes, you can apply within your first 90 days of creating a workspace.

###

Yes to both. Attio has a REST API, an App SDK, and an MCP server – so you can connect your GTM stack, build custom automations, or plug Attio directly into AI coding agents and automation tools. It's all documented at [attio.com/platform/developers](https://attio.com/platform/developers).

###

Yes – Attio connects with the tools most early-stage teams already run on. That includes Clay, Slack, Granola, Zapier, Gmail, Google Calendar, and more. You can browse the full app store at [attio.com/apps](https://attio.com/apps). If you need something custom, the [API and SDK](https://attio.com/platform/developers) are there too.

###

An agentic CRM is a CRM that uses AI natively – not as a bolt-on. Attio is built this way from the ground up: AI that researches and enriches records, surfaces signals, automates outreach, and lets you search and update your CRM in plain language.
